MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

3. Solve for x: x + 9 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 16
   D. 7

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 41
   C. 43
   D. 31

5. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

6. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

9. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 12

10. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

13. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 48

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

15. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
